args.common: ROUND 4 of the water work (23 Nov 07:23, launched by the lead; the client is waking up; nothing merges into MAIN without the client's OK). CLIENT'S WORDS (verbatim, 22 Nov): (1) 'cek flicker tulil.mov, ITUU GOBLOG' = desktop: blocky dark shapes along the left ice sheets' waterline reflections while the camera moves; (2) 'gila, itu reflection yang bongkahan es belakang kek kontol banget, vertical line gitu doang anjing, kasar banget' = the far ice chunks' reflections are rough, flat vertical lines; (3) 'cek bibir air jelek.mov, bagian situ juga anjing jelek bangetttt refleksi air dan tepi bongkahan es nyaa' = the water lip and the ice edges at the far slabs. Client videos: MAIN/flicker tulil.mov and MAIN/bibir air jelek.mov (look at them). The client's machine: base Apple M4 = T1, DPR 2. Standing words: 'please make no mistakes', awwwards site-of-the-day level. STATE: complaint 1 is SOLVED by the release candidate LANES/wl3a (lab :5169) = p4wl + wl2g + WL2FJ + wl3a + wl3c. Its judge passed it and called it mergeable (MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4wl3c/judge_wl3c/LOG.md): left water at T1 DPR 2 13-21 % below MAIN in the dt-controlled real loop; perf +2.5 % (STRICT sweep vs MAIN); no regressions. BASE FOR ROUND 4: LANES/wl3a (:5169), FROZEN: never edit it, never stop :5169. ROUND 4 = complaints 2 and 3. Two attempts failed; read their judges first: MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4wl2/judge_wl2b/LOG.md and MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4wl3/judge_wl3b/LOG.md. Their lessons: (a) longer / brighter columns that also widen the LEFT ice sheets' reflections made complaint 1 worse (+90 %): gate any lengthening BY THE FACE (only far slab faces beyond the left-water distances), not by camera distance; (b) perf went +7.6 %: the 8-face cap everywhere and the lip bisection everywhere cost too much; the whole stack must stay <= +5 % vs MAIN and the base already uses +2.5-2.8 %, so your lane may add about +2 % at most; (c) K raised every column, some 2x over-bright: scale K by each column's deficit against REF (the far-left columns already match REF at K = 1); (d) breaks: coarse bars (gain 2.5-5) or 1-px scanlines (T10) failed; REF's breaks are about 9 px; add them from the mip-filtered lake_chop slope only once the flicker gates pass; (e) lips: anchoring tN at the bisected crossing removed the teeth in stills (4x sheets matched the GT), but lifting the face-colour lookup dF lost the slab feet's dark contact band (away from REF) and made a pale notch at CSS x ~1061; keep the face's dark colour down to the foot; the lip band must not pop more than MAIN in the real loop; (f) a thin bright vertical streak near the floe tip at CSS x ~1256 (in wl2, MAIN and the GT have none): root-cause it before widening any share; until then exclude single-texel-wide hits. TOOLS: $SP/work_p4/p4wl/tools; cols.py / colmatch.py / blips.py in $SP/work_p4/judge_wl2b/tools; the dt-controlled real loop rl.mjs in $SP/work_p4/judge_wl2/tools; round 3c's tables in MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4wl3c/. THE BAR, every item on your FINAL build: (1) Complaint 1 must not regress: in the dt-controlled real loop at T1 DPR 2 (alternate base / lane >= 4 times each, n >= 100 per band), the left water and the left region stay <= the base (:5169) and <= MAIN. (2) Complaint 2 (lane wl4c): the far columns move toward ref_F000 by cols.py / colmatch.py (REF median 82 px / excess 22.3 at T1 rest; MAIN 50 / 16.2), no column over-bright vs REF, broken like REF (no smooth crisp bands, no bars, no scanlines); far-box blips <= GT; the x ~1256 streak gone or not stronger. (3) Complaint 3 (lane wl4l): no tooth / step at the slab feet in 4x same-pose sheets MAIN | base | lane | GT; the dark contact band kept (vs REF); no pale notch; the lip band <= MAIN in the quiet real loop at T1 DPR 2 (n >= 100). (4) Perf: the whole stack vs :5162 <= +5 % on the T1 pointer sweep with >= 8 valid STRICT pairs (report the paired median and both modes) and at rest. (5) No new sparkle at 60 fps; FAIR fast + reverse at least (all six paths for the integrator). (6) ?<your switch>=0 IDENTICAL to :5169 and ?p4wl=0 IDENTICAL to :5162 (ident at T1, T2, T0 phone, p04 / p06 / p07). (7) The ice rings' look unchanged; T0 phones unchanged; tsc clean in both configs; 0 console errors. CLIENT FILES: REF | MAIN | lane crops at 1x / 2x and a short mp4 at T1 DPR 2 into MAIN/notes/round11/refs_user/wl4_<lane>_*. Short dated LOG entries; delete capture sets once analysed (keep < 3 GB per WORK); never start a heavy job outside the slot ($SP/slot/slot.mjs); self-gate before ok = true.

wl4c.build: LANE wl4c (lab :5181): COMPLAINT 2, the far ice chunks' reflection columns, on the frozen base wl3a. Lengthen and brighten ONLY the far slab faces' columns (gate by face, lesson a), scaled by each column's deficit vs REF (lesson c). Root-cause the x ~1256 streak first (lesson f). Keep the cost small: about +2 % on top of the base (lesson b). Then add REF-like breaks of about 9 px from the mip-filtered lake_chop slope (lesson d). Show each step's numbers (cols.py / colmatch.py per column vs REF, far-box blips vs GT, the left-water real loop vs base) and the look at 1x / 2x / in motion. Switch ?wl4c=0 = :5169 exactly. Own the far-column share / K / breaks; lane wl4l owns the slab-foot lips (tN anchor, dF, contact band): stay out of those hunks and say exactly what you changed.
wl4c.judge: Judge lane wl4c against complaint 2 and THE BAR: REF | MAIN | base | lane crops at 1x / 2x at rest and in motion (T1, T2); cols.py / colmatch.py per column vs REF (no column over-bright); breaks vs REF (no bands, bars or scanlines); far-box blips vs GT; the x ~1256 streak; complaint 1 not regressed (your own alternated real loop at T1 DPR 2 vs :5169 and MAIN); perf (>= 8 STRICT pairs yourself), ident, sparkle, FAIR fast + reverse; anything worse anywhere. LENSES: environment, color_grade_post, glitch_cursor_orbit, awwwards_jury.

wl4l.build: LANE wl4l (lab :5182): COMPLAINT 3, the water lips and ice edges at the far slabs ('bibir air jelek.mov'), on the frozen base wl3a. Remove the teeth / steps at the slab feet (anchor tN at the bisected crossing or the level-0 grid; lesson e) while keeping the face's dark colour down to the foot (the contact band, checked against REF) and no pale notch. Prove it with 4x same-pose sheets MAIN | base | lane | GT of the slab feet, REF crops, and the real loop. Switch ?wl4l=0 = :5169 exactly. Own the lips' tN / dF / contact band; lane wl4c owns the far-column share / K / breaks: stay out of those hunks and say exactly what you changed.
wl4l.judge: Judge lane wl4l against complaint 3 and THE BAR: 4x same-pose sheets of the slab feet MAIN | base | lane | GT (teeth, steps, the contact band, notches); REF crops; the lip band in your own quiet real loop at T1 DPR 2 (alternated, n >= 100) vs MAIN and :5169; complaint 1 not regressed; perf (>= 8 STRICT pairs yourself), ident, sparkle, FAIR fast + reverse; anything worse anywhere. LENSES: environment, glitch_cursor_orbit, glitch_hold_sweep, awwwards_jury.

args.integrate: INTEGRATOR: create lane LANES/wl4 as an APFS clone of LANES/wl3a (cp -c -R), lab :5183. Take each round-4 lane whose judge passed, or whose open findings are minor or nit only; a lane with an open blocker or major stays out (say why). Merge the taken lanes 3-way onto wl3a (base = LANES/wl3a), keeping each switch (?wl4c=0, ?wl4l=0). All switches off must equal :5169 exactly, and ?p4wl=0 must equal :5162. Then run THE BAR in full on the merged build: complaint 1 not regressed, the complaint 2 / 3 checks, perf (the whole stack <= +5 % vs MAIN, >= 8 STRICT pairs), FAIR on all six paths, sparkle, ident and tsc. Write the client files refs_user/wl4_merged_* and the patch vs LANES/p4ph/retrux-web/app (= the whole stack that would merge into MAIN). ok = false if any item fails (say which). If nothing qualifies, take nothing (changed = false).
